However, this old uncle was very calm. He seemed to know that Qin Fen and Ye Tinghao did not leave him alone, but were preparing something. Although this hilltop belonged to Youtang Village, most of us onlookers were not from Youtang Village. When the village chief saw that we were not leaving, he naturally did not dare to do anything to us. After all, their number of people in Youtang Village was smaller than that of Huimen Village, and they did not dare to offend the people of several nearby villages. The aura was released and fell on Sima Xiongfeng. The "urban plan" implemented behind the capital was actually another type of investment immigration, with great limitations. There was no such simple and crude policy as buying a house. Although they didn't know who this Zhao Wu was, the word "Zhao" in Tianxuan Xingchen meant that he was a member of the Zhao family. In other words, this seemingly old man actually killed a member of the Zhao family? "Not necessarily, some people create tombs to prevent future generations. Someone robbed the tomb, so the opening was sealed so that no one could enter. It seems like this is what happened to Qin Shihuang's Mausoleum." Emperor Mu squatted on the ground, carefully inspected the entrance of the cave, and murmured. Luo Feng's appearance was half that of his father, Luo Yuyang, and half of his mother. It didn't take much to tell who Luo Feng was. It was just a joke at this time. Lou promised to buy Lin Ming a cup of coffee first, and then let her sit at a table by herself.
